shouldFix.title: Do not claim that a DR-G obligation or owner was named when both remain future work
shouldFix.finding: The purpose says this artifact will name the later DR-G* obligation, proposedObligation.ownsAllSevenNTs is true, and the CLAUDE-PONGJ-V1-SF1 disposition says classes.*.owner lands the ownership repair. In fact, every owner value is the same placeholder—'later DR-G* obligation named by a later D-000 cycle; not this candidate'—and the subject supplies no obligation identifier, claim, harness attachment, retained evidence, role owner, or live condition-4 cell. That placeholder is neither an obligation name nor an owner. The later paragraph correctly admits that all seven NTs remain leftover-design until a later D-000 names an obligation with an owner, so this is an overstatement rather than a false eligibility claim.
shouldFix.impact: The candidate cannot truthfully claim to have named the obligation, assigned ownership, or fully landed the cited ownership finding. D-056 gate 3 remains unmet, as the subject otherwise acknowledges.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Choose one consistent boundary: either define the proposed DR-G obligation and a real role owner while keeping it candidate-not-applied, or reframe purpose, proposedObligation.ownsAllSevenNTs, and findingDisposition to say this artifact only records the need for a later naming-and-ownership act and does not land that part of the repair.

shouldFix.title: Remove the stale D-086-only route from the top-level authority claim
shouldFix.finding: authorityClaim still describes classes as needing 'a later D-086 named harness'. That is the predecessor's identifier-first route and conflicts with basedOn.relation, proposedObligation.notABareD086Identifier, doesNot, and D-056 gate 3, all of which correctly require a condition-4 / DR-G* obligation with an owner rather than a bare D-086 identifier.
shouldFix.impact: The load-bearing summary leaves two incompatible descriptions of the required successor act and makes the CLAUDE-PONGJ-V1-B2 repair ambiguous even though the detailed clause is correct.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Rewrite authorityClaim to require a later D-000 act that names a DR-G* obligation with a role owner; describe any D-086 harness identifier only as attached evidence under that obligation, not as the obligation or gate-3 result.

summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 2 SHOULD-FIX. The v2 subject conservatively withdraws every G10 join, explicitly rejects a bare D-086 identifier as sufficient for D-056 gate 3, and makes no leftover-closure, eligibility, SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, implementation, or register-edit claim. However, it also says it names the later DR-G obligation and lands ownership while providing only a future-D-000 placeholder, and its top-level authority claim still uses the obsolete later-D-086-named-harness route. Those inconsistencies must be repaired before a zero-finding ACCEPT.
